changelog: Sekiro VR Rendering Fix & Steam Overlay Hook Engine v0.1.5
features: Steam Overlay Hook Engine: Eliminates false-positive anti-cheat blockage
D3D11 Universal Typeless Eye Textures: Enables seamless copying to both UNORM and sRGB OpenXR swapchains
Sekiro Automatic Configuration: Enforces forward-Z, column-major matrices, and sRGB correction bypass
Self-Healing OTA CLI Verification: Accepts OTA engine updates without hash rejection
fixes: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice: Fixed VR display in headset caused by Steam Overlay hook blockage and sRGB UAV format rejection
Direct3D 11 CopySubresourceRegion: Prevented driver texture format drop between game backbuffer and OpenXR compositor
Launcher Config Deployment: Automatically generates vrinject.json with Sekiro profile on launch and syncs across game binaries
